title: Owl Semaphore Badge System
description: Owl Semaphore v2.0.2. Editorial science/citation remediation release on top of v2.0.1: restricts the Goedel reference to a structural analogy; softens or qualifies clinical language (ego-dystonic, aporia); reframes Newton/Einstein as a limiting-case relation; aligns the metacognition / ICD 203 framing as a functional parallel rather than identity; adopts canonical RFC 2119 / RFC 8174 / BCP 14 boilerplate; names Bertin's six retinal variables explicitly; qualifies CVD prevalence as Northern-European-descent; removes metaphysical overclaim from the core framing; preserves the EXPLANATION story-table overflow fix from v2.0.1. No changes to the V4 algebra, the sigma_h assignment to METACOGNITIVE, the canonical formal sentence, the accessibility rule, the asset set, or the canonical math tuples. The source snapshot cites the stable concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19473697; the v2.0.2 version-specific DOI will be minted by Zenodo on release and recorded in the GitHub release notes. Previous published version DOI (v2.0.1): 10.5281/zenodo.20419874. Earlier published version DOIs: 10.5281/zenodo.20418539 (v2.0.0), 10.5281/zenodo.19474599 (v1.2.0).
